# VN Healthy Living Medical Group

> VN Healthy Living Medical Group (VNHL) is an independent solo-practice internal medicine and primary care clinic in Imperial Beach, California, led by Dr. Vijay Kuppurajan, MD ("Dr. K"), a board-certified physician affiliated with Sharp Health Plan and Sharp Community Medical Group (SCMG). We care for adults age 18 and older, including seniors, and offer senior wellness and medical weight management.

## Services
- Senior Wellness: Medicare Annual Wellness Visits (typically $0 co-pay for eligible Medicare patients), preventive screenings, medication review, and chronic condition management.
- Primary care for adults 18+: annual physicals, diabetes, hypertension and high cholesterol management, acute illness visits, on-site blood work, and anxiety and depression screening.
- Medical Weight Management: physician-supervised programs, including GLP-1 therapy when appropriate. Medicare members, including Medicare Advantage members, may be eligible for the Medicare GLP-1 Bridge Program; the office reviews eligibility individually.
- Bilingual care in English and Spanish (Hablamos Español).
- Specialist referrals are coordinated through the Sharp and SCMG network. No referral is needed to see Dr. K.

## Insurance
- Private insurance: most plans, including Aetna, Humana, United Healthcare, Cigna, and many more.
- Medicare: Original Medicare with or without a supplement.
- Medicare Advantage: Sharp-SCMG Advantage plans only.
- Call VNHL at (619) 429-7700 to clarify your specific plan.

## Visit and Contact
- Address: 707 Palm Ave, Imperial Beach, CA 91932 (next to the Hampton Inn & Suites, corner of Palm Ave and 7th)
- Phone: (619) 429-7700
- Hours: Monday to Thursday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM; Friday 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM
- Public transit: MTS Bus Routes 933 and 934
- New patients: accepted (adults 18+). Appointments are scheduled by phone; same-day sick visits are often available when you call early.
- Areas served: Imperial Beach, Chula Vista, National City, San Ysidro, Coronado, and South Bay San Diego
